mapper.sql: form_code, form_name, integration_type, erp_source_menu, html_template_key, use_email, use_board, enabled, sort_order, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM eap_form_config ORDER BY sort_order, form_code
SELECT FROM eap_form_config WHERE enabled = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order, form_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eap_form_config ( form_code, form_name, integration_type, erp_source_menu, html_template_key, use_email, use_board, enabled, sort_order, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( TRIM(#{formCode}), TRIM(#{formName}), COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{integrationType}), ''), 'v4'), NULLIF(TRIM(#{erpSourceMenu}), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(#{htmlTemplateKey}), ''), COALESCE(#{useEmail}, FALSE), COALESCE(#{useBoard}, FALSE), COALESCE(#{enabled}, TRUE), COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE eap_form_config SET form_name = TRIM(#{body.formName}), integration_type = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{body.integrationType}), ''), integration_type), erp_source_menu = NULLIF(TRIM(#{body.erpSourceMenu}), ''), html_template_key = NULLIF(TRIM(#{body.htmlTemplateKey}), ''), use_email = COALESCE(#{body.useEmail}, use_email), use_board = COALESCE(#{body.useBoard}, use_board), enabled = COALESCE(#{body.enabled}, enabled), sort_order = COALESCE(#{body.sortOrder}, sort_order), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE form_code = #{formCode}
